matrix.classification: REUSE if same fully known allocation; otherwise REGENERATE only as new attributable event
matrix.rule: Before allocation no identities exist to reuse. Known accepted allocation + byte-identical immutable context -> reuse exact set. Proven no accepted allocation -> initial/new entire allocation; unknown history -> DENY/QUERY-FIRST, never claim absent=zero.

Same existing allocation event/purpose/IDs and source context, no relevant durable effect/expiry or changed immutable input -> retain all ten. Context change is a new preparation, never a fieldwise repair. No new signature/window minted here.

Classify exact original nonsecret plan/allocation and canonical receipts before retry. Do not regenerate IDs or erase their root. Reuse is identity classification only, not permission to continue signing or reopen retired governance; crash cleanup remains later gate.

IDs identify the original logical signed input; never regenerate one ID and pair it with the old signature. Query exact stored state. No expired signature, retired-key reuse, or new signing/window authority inferred from identity continuity.

matrix.classification: REUSE only for exact known logical registration; otherwise DENY
matrix.rule: A confirmed complete rollback with exact same immutable registration bytes and independently still-valid ceremony authority may retain original IDs; no new signed envelope/secret/window minted to retry. Lack of still-valid authority or changed bytes ends continuation. A later new event only after old root is proven closed uses a whole fresh identity set; no cleanup design added.

Inspect exact binding_id and (incarnation,plan_id), immutable38-field values/hash/retained original and existing receipts under already authorized trusted ADMIN. Exact complete registration -> acknowledgment/replay inspection only; conflict -> DENY; uncertain absence -> DENY. No UPSERT, no second registration/effect and no automatic regeneration.

idempotency.logical_preparation_identity: Existing final ceremony accepted allocation context identified by (incarnation,plan_id,run_id,binding_id) and exact allocated ID set/immutable approved scope. No extra ceremony-attempt UUID/table.
idempotency.server_attempt_separate: offline_attempt.attempt_id plus generation and execution/instance ownership are later server/launcher identities; never equated to plan_id or run_id. Same binding may support governed later generations without a new plan identity.
idempotency.classification: Same frozen allocation/context and exact semantic request is a logical retry. Changed immutable context, a proven closed/abandoned root followed by newly authorized preparation, or a different plan_id is a new logical allocation/ceremony. An operational generation change alone is not a new binding or plan. Unknown lineage denies both mutation and regeneration.
idempotency.no_idempotency_table: Existing immutable registration uniqueness/tombstones and command operation receipts suffice. Pre-effect context uses existing plan/input recovery representation; its crash persistence mechanics remain separate, no new storage system here.
idempotency.fingerprint_role: Derived commitment to complete semantic38-field plan; not independent authority or replacement for primary/unique keys. Equality alone never makes a replay executable.

operational_attempt_vs_preparation: The logical ceremony preparation identity is not a new server attempt_id; server attempt/generation/execution/ownership stays SPEC0090 section6. A new operational attempt can retain the same binding under existing recovery authority.
recovery_limit: QUERY-FIRST is an identity/replay condition, not an implemented crash cleanup/recovery coordinator. Expired signatures, retired keys and delivery loss remain governed later; no resumption guarantee here.
